brief:
Robert Del Naja, a member of the British electronic music group Massive Attack, was arrested during a pro-Palestine demonstration in the United Kingdom, Al Jazeera English reported. The arrest occurred as the musician participated in protest activity related to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Details about the specific charges, location, and circumstances of the arrest were not disclosed in the initial report.
dek: Massive Attack singer arrested over pro-Palestine protest in UK…
title: Massive Attack singer arrested at UK pro-Palestine protest
